Two surfaces with different gates: the MCP server supports OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration (effectively self-serve) while the REST API sits behind a 'Request access' button. Classified REV for the REST surface; the MCP route is softer than that label implies. This is also Loop B's one surviving conflict.
Otter has a free consumer tier, but no official public REST reference was located and the Bearer-key claim comes from a third-party comparison, not Otter's docs. Confidence lowered to medium.

'REST (Aura/HTTP) + Bolt' is accurate but flattens a real distinction: the Aura management API and the per-database Query API are different products with different auth. An agent toolkit would target one or the other, not both.
